environment.mode: headless Edge local DOM, network aborted, original jQuery and exact source slices

substitutions: Widget lookup and generated object model, expression evaluation and target path resolver are explicit sinks.
fitParentPanel, event execution, annotation and visibility caches are logged sinks; events do not run authored cases.
offsetBoundingRect uses the fixture center; fixed positioning, scrolling, containment and auto-fit parent reflow are not emulated.
VM batching executes original dispatcher/queues but _addMove/_addResize/_addRotate are recording sinks.
Actual browser animation uses the retained full jQuery distribution. No vendor GUI or DLL execution.
